paragraphs: R' Simlai, in R' Elazar son of R' Shimon's name: Helek, 98a. R' Simlai expounded there, end of side b. R' Hiyya bar Abba said in R' Simlai's name: there, 106a. R' Abba, the father of R' Simlai. His father R' Abba spoke to Shmuel; see his entry. Adda said in R' Simlai's name: Sotah 38b. R' Yaakov bar Aha said in R' Simlai's name: Mo'ed Katan 16, end of side b. R' Yitzhak bar Shmuel bar Marta found him in Netzivin: Jerusalem Ein Ma'amidin, halakhah 9. R' Malkiya came to his house. R' Tanhum bar Hiyya reports in his name. R' Tanhum bar Rabbi was R' Simlai's son-in-law.
